title: Soliman 21
subtitle: A Triplex Investment Residence
description:
Located on the prestigious Bahia Soliman avenue within Puerto Aventuras, this exceptional property redefines the concept of a golf front investment. Overlooking the lush fairways, the residence offers a rare opportunity to generate passive income while maintaining a luxurious personal retreat. It is an intelligent asset designed for astute buyers who seek both elegant coastal living and steady returns.

The Residences
The architectural layout is thoughtfully divided into three distinct two bedroom apartments, ensuring absolute privacy for all occupants. The ground floor features an expansive primary residence, while the upper level hosts two additional impeccably designed units. Each apartment is delivered fully equipped with modern finishes, functional kitchens, and private terraces, providing turnkey comfort for long term tenants or vacation guests.

Curated Outdoor Spaces
The outdoor environment is crafted for relaxation and effortless entertaining. A large sparkling swimming pool serves as the centerpiece of the landscaped backyard, creating an inviting oasis right on the golf course. Ascending to the common rooftop terrace, residents are rewarded with panoramic fairway views, while a comprehensive solar energy system operates silently to maximize efficiency and minimize operational costs.

The Lifestyle and Mobility
Living in this gated community means embracing a life of supreme convenience. To ensure immediate integration into the Puerto Aventuras lifestyle, this estate includes a private golf cart and an SUV in the sale. With pristine beaches, exclusive boutiques, and fine dining just minutes away, this property delivers a complete Riviera Maya experience with zero friction.
